test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The term 'lithification' is related to which of the following geographic elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rocks.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **challenging process **of **lithification **converts loose silt grains that have recently been deposited into **rock**.
 
• After a silt is deposited, lithification may occur **immediately **or later.
 
• **Cementation **is one of the crucial processes, particularly for sandstones and conglomerates.
 
• Additionally, interactions between various minerals and between minerals and the fluids contained in the pores of a **sediment **take place.
 
• These processes, collectively known as **authigenesis**, may produce new minerals or contribute to those already present in the sediment.
 
• It is possible for minerals in solution that enter the sediment from another area to be **deposited **or to **interact **with **minerals **already **present**.
 
• In the form of **nodules **and other **concretions**, minerals can also disintegrate and be redistributed. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Sand, gravel, bones, **and **silt **are examples of material bits that have been carried by water, ice, or wind and deposited in a specific location.
 
• Other natural processes, such as **erosion**, which reduce large boulders to small pieces, may have produced these **sediments**.
 
• These minute components are subsequently transformed into **rock **through **lithification**.
 
• It is the last stage in the formation of **sedimentary rock.**
 
• **Compaction **and **cementation **are typical steps in lithification.
